Hi all 😊🇮🇱🇿🇦

Please, no negative comments — I’m just looking for some advice from people who have been through this process RECENTLY.

For those who have both South African and Israeli citizenship and are married to an Israeli citizen — how did you register your child, who was born in Israel, as a South African citizen?

Would love to hear how you went about it, where you applied, what documents you needed, and how the process was for you.

Thanks so much! 🇮🇱🇿🇦
